content: 2025 was a year defined by artistic excellence, collective achievement and renewed purpose for Guildhouse. Guided by our new Strategic Plan and Manifesto, we stepped forward with conviction as sector leaders supporting the career development and livelihoods of South Australian artists at  every stage of their career.  Our suite of nationally recognised artistic programs continued to advance practice, encourage experimentation and increase visibility for visual artists, craft makers and designers. Whilst our unique exhibition series, in traditional and non-traditional gallery spaces, connected South Australian artists and their work to new  audiences of over 2 million people.  In 2025 Guildhouse provided an ambitious suite of tailored support services and meaningful employment for artists, generating more than $1.2 million in direct income for artists, artisans and creative  workers.

subject: Aboriginal Legal Rights Movement
content: ALRM's Principal Activity was to provide Legal Services and associated support activities to the Aboriginal and Torrens Strait Islander people of South Australia, by providing comprehensive advice, support and assistance for Civil and Criminal related matters.

subject: Project Underdog Rescue Inc
content: Our charity s programs are dedicated to rescuing and supporting animals while assisting vulnerable members of our community. Through our foster program, we rescue, rehabilitate, and rehome special needs animals that might otherwise face euthanasia. Our mobile vet clinic provides fear-free, tailored veterinary care, particularly for anxious pets, helping guardians keep and care for their animals rather than surrendering them due to behavioural challenges. Additionally, our outreach programs support those in crisis, including terminally ill individuals, people at risk of homelessness, women escaping domestic violence, and communities affected by natural disasters, ensuring pets remain with their families during difficult times.
